notes.title: The Closed Beta takes a break
notes.notes:
[p]Over the past month we've been overjoyed to read the community's comments! The feedback, bug reports, and insights has been invaluable to help us determine what works and where we can improve. We’d like to take this opportunity to thank everyone who participated. We had a blast and we hope you did too![/p][p]Our focus now is on evaluating all the feedback you’ve shared with us, prioritizing improvements that make the most sense for the game, and implementing changes to make it even better. [/p][p]This is why we’re announcing today that the Closed Beta will be temporarily on pause from September 15. It will return, rest assured, and we will share details in a not so distant future.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="P512UJNDzLE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]If you participated in the first round, you’ll automatically get access to the second once it’s live. There’s no need to reapply! The same goes for those who applied but didn’t get in: you’re still in the pool of awaiting testers. And if you haven’t signed up yet, don’t worry! You can still submit your application to join [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2024600/Into_The_Unwell/"]here[/url].[/p][p]Want to discuss Into The Unwell, the Closed Beta, rubber hose animation, and everything in between? Join our [url="https://discord.gg/intotheunwell"]Discord[/url]! You can also follow us on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/shewassuchagoodhorse"]Steam [/url]and social media for [url="https://linktr.ee/suchagoodhorse"]updates[/url] on the next Closed Beta round, Early Access, and more!

[url="https://discord.gg/intotheunwell" style="button"]Join our Discord[/url][/p][p]Thank you for all the support![/p][p]Stay weird, stay wacky.
The Horses 🐎[/p]

notes.title: You might get that Closed Beta invite today!
notes.notes:
[p]The Closed Beta has been running for about a week now, and it’s been a blast reading your feedback![/p][p]Throughout the week, we’ve been letting more and more players in, and starting yesterday, we’re sending out daily waves of invites to let as many of you as possible experience [b]Into The Unwell[/b] before it hits Early Access. If you haven’t signed up yet, now’s the time! And if you already have: keep an eye on that inbox. Who knows? Your invite might already be waiting for you.[/p][p]One of our main goals with the Closed Beta is to gather as much feedback as possible. The game includes a built-in feedback feature, but we’ve also opened up dedicated channels on our Discord server where you can freely discuss your runs, find other Misfits to play with, share gameplay ideas, and report bugs. [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/intotheunwell" style="button"]Join the Into The Unwell Discord[/url][/p][p]Lucky enough to snag a key? Awesome! Just remember: since this is a Closed Beta, keep all content and spoilers inside the feedback feature or on our official Discord. [b]No sneaky peeks outside, okay?[/b][/p][p]And hey — if you haven’t gotten a key yet, don’t worry! We’re also running giveaways on the Discord, so jump in and try your luck![/p][p]We hope to see you in the Unwell soon![/p][p]Until next time —
 Stay weird, stay wacky.[/p][p]/ The Horses 🐎[/p]

notes.title: The Into The Unwell Closed Beta begins today!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello Misfits,[/b][/p][p]The doors to the Unwell creak open.[/p][p]We're beyond thrilled by the incredible response and grateful that so many of you are excited about our game. We've been closely following all the conversations on Discord — yes, even the fan art — and it's been amazing to see the community come alive! We can’t wait to hear what you think and dive into your feedback from the Closed Beta. This is just the beginning and we’re pumped![/p][p]Throughout the day, we'll be sending out invites. Unfortunately, not everyone will get in — the Unwell isn't known for its hospitality, and we simply don’t have room for all co-dependents. We'll be starting with a small batch of players and will increase that number depending on how things go![/p][previewyoutube="McZdq-oswWQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p] Here’s what you need to know:[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]How do I know if I got accepted?
[/b]If the fates smiled upon you, you'll find an email from Steam waiting. If not… well, you know where the shadows are. Please wait 12 hours before admitting defeat![/p][p][b]Can I boost my odds by reaching out?
[/b]Nope — all invitations are sent out randomly. It’s the fairest way we can do this.[/p][p][b]Am I allowed to stream the Closed Beta or share content on social media platforms such as Twitch, Youtube, Facebook, X, Bluesky and Instagram?[/b][/p][p]No, players who share content from the Closed Beta will receive an official takedown request from either us or Coffee Stain Publishing. If you’re a Youtuber who would like to stream the game at a later date, please reach out to us![/p][p][b]I’m a journalist / writer. Am I allowed to write articles based on the Closed Beta?[/b][/p][p]The same rules apply here: please don’t share any impressions in articles or on social media. If you're interested in covering the game, reach out to us or Coffee Stain Publishing![/p][p][b]Is the full game in the Closed Beta?
[/b]No — you’ll explore the first world. Just enough to pull you in… not enough to let you out.[/p][p][b]Can I play with friends?
[/b]Yes. Misery loves company — you’ll be able to invite up to two friends to join you.[/p][p][b]How long will the Closed Beta last?
[/b]We haven’t locked in an end date yet but we’re all about that feedback life right up until launch![/p][p][b]Will my saves carry over into Early Access?[/b][/p][p]Sadly not. Please be aware that there's a risk Closed Beta saves may be wiped due to maintenance on our end. After all, this is a test, and things might get a little wonky.

[b]Can I give feedback?
[/b]Please do. [b]The Closed Beta will ship with a feedback feature[/b], and if you encounter something strange (stranger than the Unwell), or just want to share your wackiest gameplay ideas, let us know by using it! Your insights are fuel for what’s to come.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Make sure to join our [url="http://discord.gg/IntoTheUnwell"]Discord server[/url] to chat with other players, follow us on [url="https://linktr.ee/suchagoodhorse"]social media[/url], and sign up for [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Ftb397404b.emailsys2a.net%2F295%2F816%2Fd127ec7da5%2Fsubscribe%2Fform.html%3F_g%3D1749247859"]the newsletter[/url] to stay in the loop.[/p][p]Thanks again for the support — we’re excited to finally share a piece of the Unwell with you.[/p][p]Until then —[/p][p]Stay weird, stay wacky. 
[/p][p]/ The Horses 🐎[/p]

notes.title: Relapse in style in the Unwell!
notes.notes: [p]Welcome to [b]Into The Unwell[/b]. It’s time for your therapy session. Or not. Since you are here, you are probably beyond help anyway.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="jSbCTTzBP64;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Into The Unwell[/b] started as a passion project with one major goal: Make a game so good, so juicy, and as off its rocker as a nine man team of caffeinated Swedes can manage.[/p][p]The result is a steaming hotpot of third-person action roguelite madness we’ve been cooking for the past three years. It’s a fever dream cocktail of rubber hose mayhem, filled with bittersweet self-destruction ready to be injected straight into your eyeballs. A hideaway for Pedro to crawl into and never come back.  [/p][p][b]Into The Unwell[/b] is heading to Early Access later this year, and we’re inviting you to dive face-first into the mayhem. Closed beta sign-ups are now open for our upcoming playtest —hit that Steam Playtest button to secure your spot, and join our Discord so you don’t miss a single update or cursed surprise.[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/SJaBnJFsgj" style="button"]Join Our Discord[/url][/p][p]Wishlist [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2024600/Into_The_Unwell/"]Into The Unwell[/url][/b] (It’s the first step on the road to recovery. Or relapse. We’re not judgmental), follow us on [url="https://linktr.ee/suchagoodhorse"]social media[/url] and sign up for our [url="https://tb397404b.emailsys2a.net/295/816/d127ec7da5/subscribe/form.html?_g=1749247859"]newsletter[/url].[/p][p]Stay weird, stay wacky.[/p][p]/ The Horses 🐎[/p]
